preRestore.name: Install certbot, dns-route-53, dns-cloudflare, create folder for creds
preRestore.command: snap install core; snap refresh core; snap install --classic certbot; snap set certbot trust-plugin-with-root=ok; snap install certbot-dns-route53; snap set certbot trust-plugin-with-root=ok; snap install certbot-dns-cloudflare; mkdir -p /root/.aws/; mkdir /etc/letsencrypt; mkdir /root/.aws;
